Name: MENU_VALUE_TABLE_SPEC
Description: Value-to-text tables for the property panels. A MenuPropertySpecParam Format Type equal to a row ID starts a table: that row and the rows with the following IDs (until an ID is missing) are checked in order, and the first match gives the text. If none matches, the last row's text is used.

Fields.Name: Value
Fields.Description: Value the property is compared with (see Compare Type).

Fields.Name: Text ID
Fields.Description: Menu text shown when this row matches.

Fields.Name: Compare Type
Fields.Description: 0: matches when the property equals Value. 1: matches when the property is Value or more. 2: always matches (catch-all). Other values never match.
